newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-PANATHINAIKOS STRIKER ALEXOUDIS OUT WITH KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PANATHINAIKOS STRIKER ALEXOUDIS OUT WITH KNEE INJURY.

text.p: Greek international striker Alexis Alexoudis, who plays for Athens club Panathinaikos, broke his kneecap during a Greek cup match and will need surgery, club officials said on Friday.
"He will undergo surgery on Monday. He'll be out for at least a month," a Panathinaikos official said.
Alexoudis was injured on Wednesday in Panathinaikos' 4-0 win over Panahaiki in the cup semifinals.
In the final on April 16, Panathinaikos will face Cup holders AEK who beat league leaders Olympiakos 1-0 in the other semifinal.
Panathinaikos are trailing Olympiakos by four points in the league standings.
